description: Add folderURL parameters to ShoppingListFiles.readText and writeText, bracket startAccessingSecurityScopedResource on folderURL instead of the file URL, and update entry/exit logs to include folder path and didStart.
acceptance_criteria: ShoppingListFiles.readText has signature accepting from url and folderURL.

handoff_summary.risks: Build is broken until all call-site beads complete; sibling beads must not merge before their call-site updates land.

handoff_summary.conflict_risks: Any bead that reads or writes ShoppingListFiles.readText/writeText call sites will see compile errors until the call-site beads land; those beads should not be merged before they update their respective files.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: folderURL is a required (non-optional, non-default) parameter to make incorrect usage a compile-time error rather than a silent runtime failure.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests written; tester bead will validate correct bracketing behaviour end-to-end.
